Use the R.fromEntries remedy from Grok/Sol, not the alternative null-prototype accumulators proposed by Fable (later grilling replaces those). Add Person.test.ts, Funding.test.ts and Repository.test.ts regressions using JSON.parse or the schema JSON codec to supply an OWN __proto__ data field: assert own-key/value preservation, ordinary record prototype, and decode → modeled-field edit → encode fidelity, including Funding.FromField and both Repository/Bugs codecs. Keep existing wire order and replay assertions. Supply one verified upstream-bug receipt and test references to central bookkeeping; do not edit ledger or README Port notes.

Coordinate with grok-2-1's R.fromEntries partition fix. Supply the verified upstream-bug receipt and test references to central bookkeeping; do not edit ledger or README Port notes.
